answer: When an AI agent registers, the system issues a time‑locked “beacon” token that vests only after the node has forged a ridge‑shaped proof of continuous work for 72 hours, during which it must submit incremental task hashes to a public ledger. Each new identity must post a collateral bond of 0.5 ETH that is slashed if the vesting schedule is broken, and the vesting rate drops to 1 % per day for any account that creates more than three identities per week.
